600: pub open spec fn segment_u_max(s: Set<SegmentId>) -> int
601:     decreases s.len()
602: {
603:     if s.len() == 0 {
604:         0
605:     } else {
606:         let x = s.choose();
607:         vstd::math::max(segment_u_max(s.remove(x)), x.uniq)
608:     }
609: }

1115:             let cs2 = ThreadCheckedState {
1116:                 pages: cs.pages.remove(page_id)
1117:             };

1119:             require forall |idx: nat| old_num_blocks <= idx < new_num_blocks
1120:                 ==> Self::okay_to_add_block(ts, page_id, idx, block_size);
1121: 
1122:             birds_eye let ssa = pre.segment_shared_access[page_id.segment_id];
1123:             let block_map = Map::new(
1124:                 range_block_ids(old_num_blocks, new_num_blocks, page_id, block_size),
1125:                 |block_id: BlockId|
1126:                   BlockState {
1127:                       segment_shared_access: ssa,
1128:                       page_shared_access: ts.pages[page_id].shared_access,
1129:                       page_slice_shared_access: ts.pages[block_id.page_id_for_slice()].shared_access,
1130:                       heap_id: None,
1131:                   }
1132:             );

1138:             add thread_local_state += [ thread_id => ts2 ];
1139:             add thread_checked_state += [ thread_id => cs2 ];
1140:         }

2645: pub open spec fn page_organization_pages_match_data(
2646:     page_data: PageData,
2647:     pla: PageLocalAccess,
2648:     psa: PageSharedAccess,
2649:     page_id: PageId,
2650:     popped: Popped) -> bool
2651: {
2652:     psa.points_to.is_init() && (
2653:     match (*pla.count.value(), *pla.inner.value(), *pla.prev.value(), *pla.next.value()) {
2654:         (count, inner, prev, next) => {
2655:             &&& (match page_data.count {
2656:                 None => true,
2657:                 Some(c) => count as int == c
2658:             })
2659:             &&& (match page_data.full {
2660:                 None => true,
2661:                 Some(b) => inner.in_full() == b,
2662:             })
2663:             &&& (match page_data.offset {
2664:                 None => true,
2665:                 Some(o) => psa.points_to.value().offset as int ==
2666:                             o * SIZEOF_PAGE_HEADER
2667:             })
2668:             &&& (match page_data.dlist_entry {
2669:                 None => true,
2670:                 Some(page_queue_data) => {
2671:                     &&& is_page_ptr_opt(prev, page_queue_data.prev)
2672:                     &&& is_page_ptr_opt(next, page_queue_data.next)
2673:                 }
2674:             })
2675:             &&& (match page_data.page_header_kind {
2676:                 None => {
2677:                     (page_id.idx == 0 ==> {
2678:                       &&& !page_data.is_used
2679:                       &&& (match popped {
2680:                           Popped::SegmentCreating(sid) if sid == page_id.segment_id =>
2681:                               true,
2682:                           _ => inner.xblock_size != 0
2683:                       })
2684:                       &&& (!popped.is_SegmentCreating() ==> inner.xblock_size != 0)
2685:                     })
2686:                     && (page_id.idx != 0 ==> page_data.offset == Some(0nat) ==> (
2687:                         (!(popped.is_Ready() && popped.get_Ready_0() == page_id) &&
2688:                             !(popped.is_VeryUnready() && popped.get_VeryUnready_0() == page_id.segment_id && popped.get_VeryUnready_1() == page_id.idx))
2689:                           ==>
2690:                         (page_data.is_used <==> inner.xblock_size != 0)
2691:                     ))
2692:                 }
2693:                 Some(PageHeaderKind::Normal(_, bsize)) => {
2694:                     &&& page_id.idx != 0
2695:                     &&& page_data.is_used
2696:                     &&& inner.xblock_size != 0
2697:                     &&& inner.xblock_size == bsize
2698:                     &&& page_data.is_used
2699:                     &&& page_data.offset == Some(0nat)
2700:                 }
2701:             })
2702:         }
2703:     })
2704: }
